title: npm 11 drops a bin path written with ./
body:
Write bin paths without a leading ./ ("src/cli.js"), and before publishing read package.json out of the packed tarball (npm pack, then tar --force-local -xOf) to confirm bin survived; watch for 'npm auto-corrected some errors' in npm publish output.

Why: npm 11.6 removed "./src/cli.js" as an invalid script name at publish time, only as a warning, which would have shipped the package without its deltadictum command and broken the Codex install.

v1.trigger: Before publishing deltadictum or editing bin in package.json
